sn_aia_tool.description: Retrieves the business loan service case from sn_bom_loan_b2b_service (FSO Business Loan Service Case table). Falls back to sn_customerservice_case with LNB prefix. Returns case status, outstanding requirements, contact email, and account name.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"customer_sys_id":{"type":"string","description":"The sys_id of the customer_contact record from Retrieve_Customer_Profile."},"account_sys_id":{"type":"string","description":"The sys_id of the customer_account record from Retrieve_Customer_Profile."},"business_name":{"type":"string","description":"Business/account name to search loan cases by (fallback if no sys_ids)."},"case_number":{"type":"string","description":"Specific loan case number (e.g. LNB0000501) to look up directly."}},"required":[]}
sn_aia_tool.name: Query_Loan_Case
